jobs.degreeText: • Bachelor's (Honors) or equivalent degree with at least a second-class or equivalent CGPA, along with a second-class Master's or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Information and Communication Technology, or a related subject from a recognized university; • Must have at least 4 (four) years of working experience as a Senior System Analyst or Senior Maintenance Engineer in a government, autonomous, semi-autonomous, or statutory organization; • Must have at least 2 publications in internationally recognized journals; • A Ph.D. degree will be considered a special qualification; • Any recognized innovation in the relevant sector will be considered a special qualification; and • A 3rd division/class in any examination throughout the academic career will not be accepted.
